3.name: TextBox 38
3.full_text:
Scientific literature review requires searching, reading, comparing and summarizing large volumes of papers.
Existing tools offer limited search or summarization, without intelligent collaboration between specialized components.
The proposed system uses multiple autonomous AI agents, each handling one sub-task of the research workflow.
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) grounds every answer in the full text of retrieved papers, reducing hallucination.
Output: a structured, citation-backed literature review with comparison table, research gaps and BibTeX/APA references.

7.name: TextBox 58
7.full_text:
Gap 1 — No end-to-end security loop
Existing work addresses secure distribution, paper variants, or watermark tracing separately; none combines all three.

Gap 2 — Leak discovery is missing

Watermarking can trace a known leak, but existing work does not actively discover leaked copies on public platforms.

Gap 3 — Reduced custody is not experimentally validated

The board → centre model is proposed conceptually; this project will implement and benchmark the reduced-hop workflow.

8.name: TextBox 63
8.full_text:
Design a digital board → centre examination-paper distribution workflow.
Generate multiple centre-specific variants of a common examination paper.
Encrypt each variant and register its cryptographic hash and metadata on a blockchain.
Implement smart-contract-based time-locking so decryption is permitted only after the exam-start timestamp.
Build a centre-facing interface for authenticated retrieval and local printing.
Add watermark/fingerprint-based leak attribution and a public-web monitoring module.
Evaluate confidentiality, integrity, release timing, traceability and detection performance.

12.name: TextBox 84
12.full_text:
The proposed architecture reduces physical custody points by moving to encrypted digital board → centre delivery.
Blockchain provides an immutable record of paper hashes, centre assignments and release events.
Time-locked access addresses the pre-exam confidentiality window.
Centre-specific variants provide a practical mechanism for leak attribution.
Future work will integrate the complete smart contract, encryption/decryption portal, public-web scraper, matching engine and end-to-end evaluation.
